name: Hinadori no Rapunzel
source:
Driven by the poverty of your home life, you, the protagonist, find yourself venturing into a forbidden forest in search of food. There, you encounter a beautiful young girl standing amidst the trees, her lovely golden hair adorned with flowers. In order to deepen your bond with this girl, you begin visiting the forest every day...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12382]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
在贫困的家庭生活的驱使下，你，主角，发现自己冒险进入禁林寻找食物。在那里，你遇到了一位美丽的年轻女孩站在树林中，她可爱的金色头发上装饰着鲜花。为了加深与这个女孩的联系，你开始每天都去森林……

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12382]Novelgame[/url]]
